text.arabic_uthmani: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٍۢ تَعْرِفُ فِى وُجُوهِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱلْمُنكَرَ ۖ يَكَادُونَ يَسْطُونَ بِٱلَّذِينَ يَتْلُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتِنَا ۗ قُلْ أَفَأُنَبِّئُكُم بِشَرٍّۢ مِّن ذَٰلِكُمُ ۗ ٱلنَّارُ وَعَدَهَا ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ

words.gloss_range: opening conjunction that resumes the prior indictment while launching a new conditional recitation scene
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) resumes the prior indictment while opening a fresh scene. The reader enters the ayah through a connected conditional hinge: whenever recitation happens, recognition, near-assault, and verdict unfold from that opening link.

topics.headline: connected conditional scene launch
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah opens as a connected new scene, not as a detached sentence.
topics.reason: The conjunction resumes prior discourse and opens the recitation encounter through a bound scene-trigger.

words.gloss_range: temporal-conditional when-frame that makes recitation the recurring trigger for visible hostility
words.prose: {{ar:إِذَا}} ({{tr:idhā}}) makes the recitation event a recurring when-frame, not a one-time report. Its temporal force and conditional structure make the recited signs the trigger that releases visible hostility, while the early pronouns lean back on the prior discourse for their audience.

topics.headline: recitation as recurring trigger
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that recitation is framed as the expected trigger that releases visible hostility.
topics.reason: The temporal adverb functions conditionally, and the pronoun chain relies on the prior discourse for its addressees.

words.gloss_range: passive ongoing recitation in which the signs are foregrounded and the reciter is withheld until later
words.root_gloss_range: reciting aloud and following in sequence; local passive recitation selects the recitation branch while keeping ordered-following pressure
words.prose: {{ar:تُتْلَىٰ}} ({{tr:tutlā}}) begins with recitation in the passive, so the signs themselves stand forward before the human reciters are named later. The imperfect and feminine singular form make this an ongoing collective exposure: the audience first faces the ordered recitation, then redirects aggression toward those who recite.

topics.headline: passive recitation foregrounds signs
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the signs first confront the audience before human reciters are named as targets.
topics.reason: The passive imperfect foregrounds the signs, the later active recitation resolves the suppressed agents, and the feminine singular form treats the signs collectively.

words.gloss_range: preposition-plus-pronoun marking the rejectors as the recipients under directed recitation pressure
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَيْهِمْ}} ({{tr:ʿalayhim}}) marks the signs as recited upon the tracked group. The attached pronoun keeps the audience already in view, and the preposition gives the delivery a bearing-down force that will recur when active reciters address the same people.

topics.headline: recitation upon the tracked audience
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the signs are not merely delivered to an audience but placed upon the same tracked group.
topics.reason: The preposition with attached pronoun marks directed recipient pressure and recurs later with active recitation.

words.gloss_range: divine signs as a possessed plural evidence-system, here promoted as subject of passive recitation
words.root_gloss_range: sign, verse, proof, and disputed return-point pressure; local nouns carry divine evidence rather than verbal action
words.prose: {{ar:ءَايَٰتُنَا}} ({{tr:āyātunā}}) presents the recited material as divine, plural, and evidentiary. The word can carry sign, verse, and proof together; the disputed return-pressure makes the signs feel like a refused point of return, while local grammar makes them the subject of passive recitation and later lets the same signs return in a new case.

topics.headline: possessed plural signs as evidence-system
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the recited material is a divine plural evidence-system rather than neutral information.
topics.reason: The plural possessive noun is the passive subject and later returns with changed case while keeping divine ownership.

topics.headline: sign and return derivation pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the signs also feel like a refused point of return, while local grammar keeps sign, verse, and proof as the selected range.
topics.reason: The derivational dispute is meaningful as pressure, but the local possessed plural noun functions as recited divine signs.

words.gloss_range: manifestly clear signs, with adjective and circumstantial force both keeping clarity attached to the recited signs
words.root_gloss_range: separation, distinction, clarification, and manifest proof; local adjective-like form selects evident clarity
words.prose: {{ar:بَيِّنَٰتٍۢ}} ({{tr:bayyinātin}}) keeps clarity attached to the signs as description and as manifest state. The b-y-n pressure is not generic brightness but distinction that should make truth recognizable, so the later hostile display answers clear proof itself; the same-surah proof formula is already present at 22:16.

topics.headline: clear-proof quality attached to signs
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the hostility answers clarity itself, not obscurity.
topics.reason: The word agrees with or states the condition of the signs, and the same-surah proof formula is echoed at 22:16.

words.gloss_range: active second-person recognition assigned to the Prophet, focused on visible denial in the faces
words.root_gloss_range: recognition, acquaintance, knownness, and moral knowledge; local verb selects perceptual recognition on faces
words.prose: {{ar:تَعْرِفُ}} ({{tr:taʿrifu}}) assigns the Prophet the active role of recognizing what appears on the faces. The verb makes denial readable by perception, and the recognition root presses against the denial root: what should be unknown or disowned becomes unmistakably known. Variant passives make that readability more general, but the surface keeps the Prophet as the addressed recognizer.

topics.headline: addressed Prophet as face-reader
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the Prophet is made the active perceiver of the denial visible on the faces.
topics.reason: The second-person active verb gives the Prophet perceptual authority over the visible state.

topics.headline: variants make the state self-readable
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that accepted variants show the state could be read impersonally, while the surface reading keeps the Prophet as active recognizer.
topics.reason: The passive variants shift agency away from the addressee but do not replace the canonical active second-person parse.

words.gloss_range: locating preposition that makes the faces the display field where inner denial becomes readable
words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) turns the faces into the field where the inner state is detected. Its in/on range lets inward denial appear on an outward surface, and the prepositional phrase is placed before the object so the reader first knows where recognition is happening.

topics.headline: faces as display field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that inner rejection is mapped into a visible field before the object of recognition is named.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the face phrase and mediates between recognizing and the recognized denial.

words.gloss_range: plural construct faces of the rejectors, serving as outward moral surfaces and orientations
words.root_gloss_range: face, front, aspect, and orientation; local construct selects physical faces as visible moral surfaces
words.prose: {{ar:وُجُوهِ}} ({{tr:wujūhi}}) makes the rejectors' faces the possessed surfaces of display. The plural construct ties the expression to the group, while the root's orientation field lets the faces function as the direction in which inner rejection becomes visible; 22:11 gives the surah another face-as-moral-indicator moment.

topics.headline: rejectors faces as moral surface
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the faces belong specifically to the rejectors and turn group rejection into visible display.
topics.reason: The construct chain, plural form, and same-surah face motif at 22:11 make faces a collective moral indicator.

words.gloss_range: definite relative pronoun that classifies the first actor group by the following rejection verb
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) identifies the group through the action that follows. The ayah does not first give an ethnic or social label; it sorts actors by clauses, beginning with those defined by rejection.

topics.headline: group defined by following act
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the people are classified by what they have done, not by an external social label.
topics.reason: The definite relative pronoun waits for the rejection clause and participates in the ayah-wide actor map.

words.gloss_range: settled collective rejection, with covering and ingratitude pressure carried into the visible face-scene
words.root_gloss_range: covering, concealment, rejection, and ingratitude; local perfect verbs select settled collective rejection
words.prose: {{ar:كَفَرُوا۟}} ({{tr:kafarū}}) names the group by a completed collective act. The covering and ingratitude field makes their response to clear signs morally charged, and the identical verb returns in the verdict clause so the face-scene and Fire-sentence are bound together; 22:19 already supplies same-surah Fire punishment imagery.

topics.headline: completed collective rejection becomes visible
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that visible hostility is tied to an established collective act of covering and rejection.
topics.reason: The perfect plural relative predicate identifies the group by settled rejection and carries the covering image into the face-scene.

words.gloss_range: the recognized repugnant denial, objectified as a definite passive-participle state on the faces
words.root_gloss_range: unfamiliarity, denial, disowning, and moral repugnance; local passive-participle noun objectifies visible denial
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمُنكَرَ}} ({{tr:al-munkara}}) is the recognized object, a definite state of repugnant denial visible in the faces. The word turns non-recognition into something recognized, holding cognitive refusal and moral ugliness together. Variant case and passive readings can make the state self-presenting, but the surface keeps it as the object the Prophet recognizes; the duty-language of forbidding wrong at 22:41 appears here as visible denial.

topics.headline: the repugnant denial is objectified
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the thing recognized is not merely an expression but a named state of repugnant denial.
topics.reason: The accusative definite passive-participle noun is the object of recognition and makes inner denial visible.

topics.headline: variant subjecthood makes denial self-presenting
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that variant grammar can make the denial-state self-presenting, while the surface reading keeps it as the Prophet recognized object.
topics.reason: The nominative and passive-recognition variants reroute subjecthood but do not replace the canonical accusative object.

topics.headline: visible denial answers moral category
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the moral category associated with forbidding wrong at 22:41 appears here as visible denial.
topics.reason: The same root links 22:41 with the face-scene, and the boundary from 22:71 shows knowledge-absence handing off to denial-display.

words.gloss_range: near-action verb that suspends the assault at the threshold while making it collectively imminent
words.root_gloss_range: nearness or almost-action; local verb of imminence holds violence at the threshold
words.prose: {{ar:يَكَادُونَ}} ({{tr:yakādūna}}) holds the assault at the edge of happening. Its valency takes the next imperfect directly, so imminence and action are compressed into one verbal unit: the threat is collective, vivid, and not yet narrated as completed.

topics.headline: near-assault held at threshold
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah maximizes the threat of violence while grammatically holding it just short of completion.
topics.reason: The verb of imminence governs a bare imperfect complement, producing a compressed near-action unit.

words.gloss_range: vivid imperfect assault verb for violent bodily seizing, sharpened by hapax status and qiraat pressure
words.root_gloss_range: falling upon, seizing, or assaulting violently; local hapax verb selects bodily near-attack
words.prose: {{ar:يَسْطُونَ}} ({{tr:yasṭūna}}) supplies the bodily content of that almost-action. The verb is a sharp hapax for violent seizing or falling upon, so the ayah moves from visible rejection toward near physical assault. The qiraat pressure can thicken the sound of the word, but the meaning remains assaultive contact.

topics.headline: rare bodily assault word
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that rejection has become near physical attack, expressed by a uniquely sharp Quranic violence word.
topics.reason: The imperfect complement denotes violent seizing after the imminence verb, and the root is supplied as a Quranic hapax.

topics.headline: variant thickens assault sound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the qiraat pressure can make the assault word sound heavier, while the local meaning remains violent seizing.
topics.reason: The variant shifts the sibilant before the emphatic consonant but preserves the same assault sense.

words.gloss_range: target-marking preposition after the assault verb, routing violent contact toward the reciters
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) routes the near-assault toward its target. After the violence verb it marks affected contact, and by governing the relative phrase it makes the whole reciter-defined group the object of aggression.

topics.headline: preposition targets the reciters
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the violence is grammatically routed toward the reciter-defined group.
topics.reason: After the assault verb, the preposition marks affected target and opens the relative phrase naming those who recite.

words.gloss_range: relative pronoun naming the assaulted party by the action of reciting
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) delays the target's identity until the reciting action is named. Grammatically it is governed by the preposition, but semantically it names the people threatened because they recite.

topics.headline: targets defined by reciting
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the assaulted party is identified by recitation itself, making the attack anti-recitation.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun is governed by the target preposition and completed by the recitation verb.

words.gloss_range: active ongoing recitation by human agents, mirroring the earlier passive recitation and exposing the reciters as targets
words.root_gloss_range: reciting and following in sequence as transmitted action; local active verb selects ongoing human recitation
words.prose: {{ar:يَتْلُونَ}} ({{tr:yatlūna}}) reveals the active reciters behind the earlier passive scene. Their ongoing recitation follows and transmits the ordered signs, so they are not inventing the provocation; they become targets precisely as agents of the same recitation.

topics.headline: active reciters answer passive opening
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the previously hidden agents of recitation become the threatened human reciters.
topics.reason: The active imperfect with plural subject mirrors the earlier passive recitation while keeping ordered-following pressure in the verb.

words.gloss_range: repeated upon-them phrase keeping the same rejector audience fixed across the voice shift
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَيْهِمْ}} ({{tr:ʿalayhim}}) repeats the same upon-them pressure under active recitation. The audience is held constant across the voice shift, so the aggression cannot be explained by a changed target: the same group receives the signs again.

topics.headline: same audience under active recitation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the target audience has not changed; only the recitation voice has shifted from passive to active.
topics.reason: The repeated preposition-pronoun form keeps the rejectors fixed as recipients across the recitation mirror.

words.gloss_range: the same divine signs now as object of active recitation, with divine possession constant through the case shift
words.root_gloss_range: sign, verse, proof, and disputed return-point pressure; local nouns carry divine evidence rather than verbal action
words.prose: {{ar:ءَايَٰتِنَا}} ({{tr:āyātinā}}) brings the same divine signs back as the object of active recitation. The plural and divine suffix stay stable while case changes, making clarity itself the content that the hostile faces and near-assault oppose.

topics.headline: divine signs shift to active object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same divine signs remain constant while moving from passive subject to active object.
topics.reason: The plural possessive noun changes case but preserves the sign-system and divine ownership.

words.gloss_range: imperative speech pivot that moves the Prophet from witness of hostility to authorized responder
words.root_gloss_range: saying/speech-command field as represented in the bundle; local imperative selects commanded prophetic counter-speech
words.prose: {{ar:قُلْ}} ({{tr:qul}}) is the major pivot from reported hostility to commanded response. The clipped imperative assigns the Prophet a divinely authorized counter-speech, turning the observer of visible denial into the speaker of a warning; 22:49 gives the surah another commanded-warning frame.

topics.headline: command moves witness into response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the structural pivot from observing hostility to divinely authorized counter-speech.
topics.reason: The imperative commands the Prophet to answer, compactly opening the quoted warning frame and echoing warning speech at 22:49.

words.gloss_range: fused question-consequence particle that turns the reply into a rhetorical warning prompted by the scene
words.prose: {{ar:أَفَ}} ({{tr:ʾa-fa}}) fuses question and consequence. The rhetorical question is not detached; it follows from their near-assault and prepares the disclosure as an answer to that scene.

topics.headline: rhetorical question follows from hostility
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the warning question is a consequence of their near-assault, not a detached inquiry.
topics.reason: The fused interrogative and consequential particle links the commanded speech to the hostile scene.

words.gloss_range: emphatic first-person informing inside commanded speech, directly addressing the rejectors with worse news
words.root_gloss_range: weighty news, disclosure, and disputed prophetic-elevation pressure; local Form II selects emphatic informing
words.prose: {{ar:أُنَبِّئُكُمْ}} ({{tr:ʾunabbiʾukum}}) layers voices: under the divine command, the Prophet says I inform you. The Form II news-verb makes the warning a weighty disclosure addressed directly to them, while prophetic-elevation pressure remains secondary to the local act of emphatic informing.

topics.headline: prophetic I delivers worse news
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the Prophet speaks as commanded first person while the warning remains divinely authorized.
topics.reason: The Form II verb carries a direct object suffix for the addressees and a content phrase for the grave disclosure.

topics.headline: news root with prophetic pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb is weighty news-delivery, while the prophetic-elevation dispute only supports the commanded speaker role.
topics.reason: The surface Form II selects emphatic informing; the n-b-w pressure does not replace the n-b-ʾ disclosure function.

words.gloss_range: content-marking preposition that attaches the informing verb to the comparative warning phrase
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) links the informing verb to its content. Here the preposition does not work as an instrument; it fastens the disclosure to the worse-than phrase that follows.

topics.headline: preposition marks warning content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the informing act is fastened to the comparative evil as its content.
topics.reason: The preposition is governed by the informing verb and scopes over the worse-than phrase.

words.gloss_range: lexicalized comparative worse in an indefinite content phrase, escalating from their hostility to a greater outcome
words.root_gloss_range: evil or harm in lexicalized comparative use here; local construction selects worse-than escalation
words.prose: {{ar:شَرٍّ}} ({{tr:sharrin}}) sets up comparison rather than generic evil. The indefinite worse-word waits for the Fire to identify its content, escalating from their hostile behavior to a greater consequence; the no-tanwin variant would tighten the phrase differently, but the surface keeps the disclosure open for the answer.

topics.headline: worse-than escalation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sentence measures their own hostility against a worse disclosed outcome.
topics.reason: The indefinite comparative noun plus following comparative marker creates the escalation frame.

topics.headline: variant tests openness of worse thing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the standard tanwin leaves the worse thing open until the Fire identifies it, while the variant tightens the phrase differently.
topics.reason: The variant without tanwin shifts toward construct pressure, but the local standard form keeps the answer delayed.

words.gloss_range: comparative marker that makes the prior hostile scene the baseline exceeded by the warning
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) makes their own scene the comparison baseline. The worse thing is measured from that visible aggression and then exceeds it.

topics.headline: baseline of comparison
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that their hostile scene becomes the scale point exceeded by the Fire.
topics.reason: The particle functions as comparative marker after the worse-word and governs the demonstrative baseline.

words.gloss_range: demonstrative with addressee suffix pointing back to their own hostile behavior as the comparison target
words.prose: {{ar:ذَٰلِكُمُ}} ({{tr:dhālikumu}}) points back to the hostile behavior and attaches it to the addressees. The demonstrative says, in effect, that one of yours, and leaves the answer slot for the Fire to fill.

topics.headline: demonstrative implicates addressees
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the comparison points back to that hostile behavior as theirs.
topics.reason: The demonstrative plus addressee suffix fixes the prior scene as the owned comparison target and leaves the answer slot for the Fire.

words.gloss_range: the definite Fire as the named worse thing, syntactically stark and concretely eschatological
words.root_gloss_range: fire and light field; local noun selects the Fire while retaining a contrast with guidance-light imagery
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلنَّارُ}} ({{tr:al-nāru}}) lands as the named answer to the worse-than question. Its definiteness and nominative break make the Fire stand out starkly, while accepted case routes show other syntactic possibilities. The wider fire/light root is narrowed here to destructive Fire for those who cover over the signs, with same-surah punishment imagery at 22:19.

topics.headline: definite Fire names the worse thing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the abstract worse thing lands as the definite Fire.
topics.reason: The nominative definite noun supplies the answer to the suspended comparison and gives the evil concrete eschatological identity.

topics.headline: case variants test Fire syntax
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that accepted case routes can smooth or reroute the Fire identification, while the standard nominative keeps the answer stark.
topics.reason: The genitive and accusative variants test apposition or object readings without changing the identified Fire.

topics.headline: fire-light root turns destructive
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the root field that can name light is here turned into destructive Fire for those who cover over signs.
topics.reason: The local noun selects Fire, while the broader fire/light root and rejection co-occurrence intensify the verdict; the same-surah punishment imagery at 22:19 supports the field.

words.gloss_range: perfect promise-threat with feminine suffix binding the appointed object back to the Fire
words.root_gloss_range: promise, threat, appointment, and fixed commitment; local object makes the promise a threat of Fire
words.prose: {{ar:وَعَدَهَا}} ({{tr:waʿadahā}}) binds the verdict back to the Fire through the feminine suffix. The perfect aspect presents the threat as already fixed, and the promise root keeps certainty even when the object makes the promise a threat; 22:47 supplies the same-surah promise-reliability background.

topics.headline: Fire bound to perfect promise-threat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the Fire is not vague punishment but the exact object of an already fixed divine threat.
topics.reason: The feminine suffix points back to the Fire, the perfect aspect fixes the commitment, and the root carries promise-threat certainty with same-surah promise reliability at 22:47.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name as the explicit post-verbal agent who appoints the Fire
words.root_gloss_range: divine name, worship/deity, and debated derivational pressures; local proper noun names the agent of promise
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:Allāhu}}) names the agent after the promise-act has landed. The proper divine name prevents the Fire from sounding like abstract fate: worship and deity pressure remain in the name, while local syntax makes the verdict appointed by the named divine subject and moves the ayah's agency from hidden recitation to explicit divine appointment.

topics.headline: promise act culminates in named agent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah moves from hidden recitation agency to the named divine agent of the verdict.
topics.reason: The proper divine name is the post-verbal subject of the promise-threat and grounds the Fire appointment in explicit divine agency.

topics.headline: proper name with worship pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices worship and deity pressure in the name, while the local syntax uses it as the proper subject of the promise-threat.
topics.reason: The derivational dispute is relevant as name pressure but the local function is the nominative agent after the verb.

topics.headline: misfiled visible-denial echo
topics.no_reader_payoff_reason: This row concerns the visible denial term and 22:41 rather than the divine-name subject at word 29; that payoff is already preserved under word 12.
topics.reason: This row concerns the visible denial term and 22:41 rather than the divine-name subject at word 29; that payoff is already preserved under word 12.

words.gloss_range: final definite relative pronoun reselecting the same rejector class as recipients of the promise-threat
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) reselects the known rejector class for the verdict. The relative form waits for the next verb, so the recipients of the promise-threat are again defined by rejection.

topics.headline: known rejectors reselected for verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verdict recipients are the same action-defined class, not a new group.
topics.reason: The final definite relative pronoun depends on the following rejection verb and repeats the opening rejector classification.

words.gloss_range: repeated perfect rejection in the verdict clause, tying the Fire recipients to the earlier visible rejection
words.root_gloss_range: covering, concealment, rejection, and ingratitude; local perfect verbs select settled collective rejection
words.prose: {{ar:كَفَرُوا۟}} ({{tr:kafarū}}) repeats the same perfect plural rejection at the point of sentence. What first identified the faces now identifies the Fire's recipients, making the act of covering and rejection carry from diagnosis to consequence.

topics.headline: same rejection becomes Fire-recipient label
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same completed rejection moves from facial diagnosis to eschatological sentence.
topics.reason: The perfect plural verb completes the final relative clause, repeats word 11, and ties rejection to Fire and destination fields.

words.gloss_range: closing conjunction that attaches the final dispraise coda to the promise-threat
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) attaches the final evaluative coda to the promise-threat. The closing judgment is connected to the Fire statement, yet it has enough force to stand as its own verdict.

topics.headline: connected evaluative coda
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final dispraise is connected to the Fire-promise while still landing as its own verdict.
topics.reason: The conjunction before the dispraise verb coordinates with the promise clause and opens the closing evaluative sentence.

words.gloss_range: frozen verb of dispraise, evaluative rather than temporal, giving the destination severe judgment force
words.root_gloss_range: wretchedness, misery, force, and severity; local frozen verb selects evaluative dispraise
words.prose: {{ar:بِئْسَ}} ({{tr:biʾsa}}) is a frozen verb of dispraise, not a past-tense report. It pronounces evaluation on the destination, and the b-ʾ-s severity field makes the judgment feel forceful as well as wretched.

topics.headline: timeless verb of dispraise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word is an evaluative verdict, not a past-tense report.
topics.reason: The frozen perfect-form verb functions as dispraise and evaluates the destination.

words.gloss_range: definite evaluated destination, both endpoint and becoming-state, sealing the ayah in a verdict formula
words.root_gloss_range: becoming, ending up, destination, and final state; local noun names the evaluated endpoint
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمَصِيرُ}} ({{tr:al-maṣīr}}) is the destination being evaluated. Its root carries ending up and becoming, so the close is not only where the rejectors go but the final state their rejection becomes. The phrase functions as a verdict formula recurring at 2:126, 3:162, 8:36, 14:29, 24:57, and 64:10.

topics.headline: destination as final becoming
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ending is not only a place arrived at but the final state into which rejection becomes.
topics.reason: The definite noun is the evaluated subject after the dispraise verb, and the root carries becoming as well as endpoint.

topics.headline: formulaic closure seals the ayah
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the closing as a recognized verdict formula, recurring at 2:126, 3:162, 8:36, 14:29, 24:57, and 64:10.
topics.reason: The phrase closes the ayah as a standard dispraise-destination formula, and the final cadence supports the endpoint.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The recognition clause, `in the faces ... al-munkar`, is enclosed by the two occurrences of reciting the signs.
baseline_models.mechanism: Manifest signs arrive as a followed vocal sequence. The addressees try to cover or refuse recognition, yet the face becomes a second sign whose visible marks disclose that refusal before the almost-assault becomes action.

activation_trace.role: Followed succession supplies the continuous recitation relay enclosing the facial reaction.
A visibly manifest sign supplies the evidence that provokes and diagnoses the response.
Emergence into clarity makes concealment unstable and prepares the counter-disclosure on the face.
Visible facial marks make the face a readable evidentiary surface rather than a neutral location.
Covering supplies the concealed act that the involuntary facial sign exposes.
Nonrecognition and denial create the paradox that their refusal is itself recognizable.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports that hostile disbelievers look angry when scripture is read.
changed_reading.after: The signs generate an involuntary counter-sign: the face makes attempted covering and nonrecognition recognizable before the hand moves.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The double recitation, the almost-assault, the imperative `say`, the announcement, and the promised destination form a sequence of speech and response.
baseline_models.mechanism: Sound follows sound until the hearers nearly answer speech with bodily force. The command to speak converts that imminent force back into an announced warning, and the warning extends the short human almost-action into a divinely fixed outcome.

activation_trace.role: One voice following another supplies the audible relay that bodily force tries to answer.
Nearness to action holds the assault at an unstable threshold rather than reporting a completed blow.
Uttered speech supplies the authorized counter-move to the threatened bodily response.
A consequential report turns the counter-speech into disclosure of an outcome.
Threatening promise gives the announced fire binding forward force.
Arrival at an outcome closes the sequence that their merely imminent action begins.

changed_reading.before: A warning of fire follows an angry interruption.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages a contest of media and timing: recited speech elicits almost-violence, then authorized speech encloses that impulse within a promised outcome.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The face presently displays what denial tries to cover, while the promised fire and bad destination occupy the final clause.
baseline_models.mechanism: The fire inventory also carries illumination, branding, and a clear track. That makes the punishment coexist with a disclosure model: the face is the preliminary visible mark of covered refusal, and fire is its irreversible final manifestation.

activation_trace.role: Covering supplies what both the face and final fire progressively uncover.
A mark recognizable on the face supplies the present, partial disclosure.
Kindled fire together with fire-branding supplies punishment as an imposed visible mark.
A clear projecting track lets the fire function as final exposure as well as pain.
The committed promise carries the partial present sign toward a future manifestation.
Final becoming turns disclosure from a passing expression into an enduring end-state.

changed_reading.before: The face shows anger now and fire punishes later.
changed_reading.after: Present face and future fire form two degrees of disclosure: refusal first leaks through a readable surface and finally becomes an inescapable manifested condition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier scene presents a visible syndrome, apparent intoxication, while denying the shallow causal label. This revises facial recognition in the focus: the surface can be evidentially true while its first conventional classification is false, so `you recognize` is an abductive diagnosis of refusal from its bodily trace.

activation_trace.role: Visual and inward seeing supplies the act of reading a bodily appearance as evidence.
Loss-of-sobriety imagery supplies the visible syndrome whose literal label the ayah immediately refuses.
Recognition by an effect or mark supplies the inferential bridge from face to concealed stance.
The outward-facing surface is the site where the inner cause becomes diagnostically available.

structural_cues: 22:2 says people are seen as intoxicated and immediately denies literal intoxication; 22:72 locates recognition in faces.
In the focus ayah, recognition precedes the almost-assault, so diagnosis is registered before action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a mismatch between visible syndrome and naive label; I infer that the focus reader identifies the deeper cause from a facial symptom. A live alternative is that the face simply displays ordinary anger without demanding diagnostic caution.

changed_reading.before: The facial munkar is a transparent emotional expression.
changed_reading.after: The face is a diagnostic surface: its disturbance is real evidence, but recognition must identify the concealed refusal rather than stop at an obvious emotion label.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier worshipper under trial turns over upon his face. That gives the focus face directional force: it is not only an expressive surface but the front on which allegiance reverses, with visible denial approaching a turn from hearing into attack.

activation_trace.role: Turning a thing from its face supplies the reversal that converts pressure into changed orientation.
Direction and destination make the face the leading edge of the worshipper's reversal.
The visible front anchors that directional model in the focus facial clause.
Change into an unrecognized or hated state supplies the altered orientation visible on the face.

structural_cues: 22:11 binds inversion directly to `upon his face` after trial.
22:72 moves from the face to an almost-completed assault, giving the visible turn a possible bodily continuation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies face-bound reversal in 22:11 and face-bound rejection in 22:72; I infer a shared orientation mechanism from reception to turning away and outward attack. A live alternative is that the repeated face language is only idiomatic and the two scenes remain independent.

changed_reading.after: Faces register a vector of allegiance: the refusal has turned the hearer away from reception and nearly forward into violence.

context_deltas.mechanism: A connection is extended, cut, tested as a scheme, and tied to pent rage in 22:15. Against the focus's doubled recitation sequence, this activates the near-assault as an interruption tactic: force aims to sever the human link carrying the signs because the signs themselves cannot be answered.

activation_trace.role: A rope-like connection supplies a material analogue for the reciter-to-hearer link.
Severance supplies the directional action assigned to threatened force against the relay.
Machination supplies purposeful interference rather than a purely reflexive outburst.
Anguish held in the chest supplies the pressure that seeks release through interruption.
Followed succession makes the repeated recitation a relay capable of being interrupted.
The split machination branch lets the context sharpen the near-action as possible strategy without replacing its ordinary threshold sense.

structural_cues: 22:15 orders connection, cutting, inspection, scheme, and rage in one chain.
22:72 repeats the recitation root on both sides of the facial reaction and uses branchless `يسطون` only as the textual action aimed at the reciters.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies connection, severance, scheme, rage, and a doubled recitation relay; I supply the arrow that the assault seeks to cut transmission by attacking its carriers. A live alternative is spontaneous rage with no strategic interruption function.

changed_reading.before: The hearers nearly lash out because they are angry.
changed_reading.after: Their near-assault is also a failed censorship mechanism: sever the carrier when the continuing sign-sequence cannot be severed by argument.

context_deltas.mechanism: Divine mention in 22:35 travels inward as heart-fear and restrained endurance. Recitation in the focus travels outward as facial distortion and nearly unrestrained force. The two scenes therefore coexist as opposite bodily processing routes for received divine speech.

activation_trace.role: Divine mention running on the tongue supplies the auditory input parallel to recitation.
Fear inwardly felt by the heart supplies the receptive body's first response.
The heart supplies the inward processing site contrasted with the focus face.
Self-restraint from panic supplies the containment absent from the almost-assault.
Following voices supply the corresponding spoken input in the focus scene.
Readable facial marks supply the rejecting body's outward response channel.

structural_cues: Both scenes begin with divine language reaching hearers and then name a bodily locus.
22:35 moves from heart-fear to restraint; 22:72 moves from face-mark to almost-assault.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two bodily responses to divine language; I infer that their opposite directions form a reception polarity. A live alternative is that the heart and face scenes are separate audience portraits with no designed physiological contrast.

changed_reading.before: The focus describes an isolated angry crowd.
changed_reading.after: The crowd exemplifies one of two somatic pathways: received speech can descend into a restrained, trembling heart or erupt through the face toward another body.

context_deltas.mechanism: The defense sequence of 22:38-40 protects attacked people and prevents the demolition of places where God's name is voiced. context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the hearing-heart-sight circuit and relocates blindness inward; I infer that the face in the focus externalizes this failed uptake. A live alternative is that the face reports social hostility without diagnosing a cognitive circuit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context distinguishes impatient demand from a promise that does not fail, then pairs extended respite with eventual seizure and destination. This sharpens the focus's temporal asymmetry: their violence is almost immediate, while the answering fire may be delayed but is more certain than their incomplete act.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies haste, nonfailure, respite, seizure, and destination; I infer that 22:72 contrasts incomplete human immediacy with delayed divine certainty. A live alternative is that `almost` describes intensity only and carries no designed temporal contrast with the promise.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context first names striving against the signs in an effort to disable, then depicts a recitation exposed to hostile insertion, removal, and renewed stabilization. This activates the focus assault as the bodily layer of a wider interference ecology: if content cannot be disabled or corrupted, force turns toward the human relay.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence selects messengers, commissions messenger and community as witnesses, demands exertion, and commands protective attachment. This turns the focus reciters from anonymous speakers into downstream nodes of a selected witness relay; violence against them targets testimony, while attachment preserves collective continuity.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies selection, messengerhood, witness succession, exertion, and preserving attachment; I infer that the focus reciters belong functionally to this relay. It remains anchored in the focus's repeated recitation, face, almost-assault, and destination, while 22:31 supplies an explicit fall-and-cast trajectory. changed_reading.after: An exploratory overthrow echo makes the scene a contest over bodily direction: hearers threaten to cast down carriers, while the ayah redirects attention to the attackers' own final trajectory.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the split `ش ر ي` inventory beneath focus `ش ر ر`, so exchange is form-distant from the ordinary comparative `worse`. It remains anchored in the explicit comparison, committed promise, evaluative blame, and destination. Downstream prose should qualify it as a transactional analogy for moral countervalue, not translate `شر` as buying or selling.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The question `shall I tell you of worse than that` evaluates the near-assault against promised fire and a blamed destination.

activation_trace.role: Exchange between sale and purchase supplies an exploratory countervalue structure for `worse than that`.
Comparison with a counterpart supplies the explicit weighing relation between threatened violence and fire.
Committed obligation supplies the liability that makes the countervalue more than a passing comparison.
Formal blame supplies the negative valuation assigned to the settlement.
Arrival at the outcome supplies the point at which the exploratory countervalue is realized.

changed_reading.before: Fire is simply said to be worse than the violence they contemplate.
changed_reading.after: The comparison can also be carried as a contained countervalue model: attempted coercion incurs a promised, negatively valued settlement at the final destination.

strongest_changes: The face changed from a transparent anger display into an involuntary counter-sign, a directional turn, and the outer output of failed inward hearing.
The almost-assault changed from spontaneous rage into coexisting interruption, suppression, and compensatory-weakness models aimed at a resilient recitation relay.
The promised fire changed from a remote add-on into delayed but fixed countertime and a final disclosure of what denial presently leaks through the face.
summary.what_was_special: The double recitation around the facial clause, the adjacent command to listen, the transmission-interference sequence in 22:51-52, and the split mappings `ت ل و` to `ت ل ل`, `ك و د` to `ك ي د`, and `ش ر ر` to `ش ر ي` kept spatial, causal, temporal, social, and exchange readings alive without forcing a single resolution.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus root `س ط و` has no branch inventory, so its assault image supports structural cues only and receives no invented branch citation.
The split-root overthrow, machination, and exchange activations are form-distant and should remain exploratory rather than lexical replacements.
The context parallels may be rhetorical echoes rather than direct causal explanations of the focus crowd.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Sequential signs become visibly rejected faces.** Repeated `ت ل و B001/B007` gives following sequence and voice following voice; `ء ي ي B003` visible signs; `ب ي ن B004/B005` clarified disclosure; `ع ر ف B003/B013` recognition by visible trace; `و ج ه B001/B002` face and orientation; `ن ك ر B001/B006` non-recognition and condemned wrong. I infer that refusal of clear recitation involuntarily writes itself onto the face. The “unrecognized/condemned” expression reads as visible counter-sign.
2. **Assault from above prefigures a worse descending outcome.** `س ط و B001` is overbearing assault from above; `ن ب ء B002` announced news; `ش ر ر B001/B003` evil and flying fire-sparks; `ن و ر B002` fire; `و ع د B002/B003` threat and appointment; `ص ي ر B007` destination. The almost-assault is answered by news of fire. I infer a reversal of vertical force: those who would pounce on reciters face a divinely appointed power beyond theirs. The warning changes immediate aggression into a sign of its own destination.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 22:73 immediately replaced threatened bodily force with a parable requiring attentive hearing, shifting the contest from assault to a testable account of agency.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Failed recognition converts epistemic pressure into bodily assault.** Fixed repeated `ت ل و:B001` supplies sequential recitation, `ءَايَات` activates `ء ي ي:B003` (visible signs), and `بَيِّنَات` activates `ب ي ن:B004/B005` (clarity and disclosure). Paradoxically, the reader can `تَعْرِف` through `ع ر ف:B003` (recognition by a mark) `ٱلْمُنكَر`, which activates `ن ك ر:B001` (non-recognition) and `B006` (condemned response), on their faces (`و ج ه:B001`). Their near action (`ك و د:B002`) becomes `س ط و:B001` (overbearing assault from above) against the reciters. `22:71` supplied lack of proof and knowledge; `22:73` commands listening to a demonstrative parable. The packet supplies clear sign, visible facial refusal, and threatened force; I infer that inability to answer at the evidentiary level is displaced into bodily domination. The face makes inward non-recognition publicly legible.
2. **The announced destination reverses who is threatening whom.** Fixed `أُنَبِّئُكُم` activates `ن ب ء:B002` (news reported), `شَرّ` uses `ش ر ر:B001`, `وَعَدَهَا` can activate `و ع د:B002` (threat directed toward harm), and `ٱلْمَصِير` uses `ص ي ر:B007` (destination). I infer that the speech redirects attention from the reciters they nearly attack to the fire already directed toward rejecters. The immediate threat is nested inside a larger promised endpoint.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later `22:73` answers threatened assault with a command to listen and a reproducible incapacity test. It converts the confrontation from force back into evidence and makes the fixed facial reaction diagnostically legible.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi oyalanma, durup bekleme, bir isin imkanini bekleme ve kalinan yer anlamlarini birlikte verir. Verilen dal cercevesi bu bekleme ve kalma cekirdegini sadik bicimde temsil eder.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal hedefe yonelme, isaret adi veya soru edati degil; bekleme ve kalma alanidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Bare kapsam, anlami kokten gelen bekleme ve kalma cekirdegiyle sinirlar; baska edat veya ad kullanimlari buraya alinmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir yerde veya bir isin basinda oyalanarak durmak, beklemek ya da kalinacak yer olarak tutulmak.

facets.statement: Kisi veya sey hareketi erteleyip durur, oyalanir ya da bekler.
Bir isin gerceklesme imkanini bekleme anlami da ayni durup bekleme cekirdegine baglidir.
Kalinan veya beklenilen yer icin konaklama ve tutulma yeri anlaminda adlasmis kullanim vardir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar dalin temelini durma, oyalanma ve bekleme olarak verir; ayrica bir isin imkanini bekleme ve kalinacak yer kullanimi ayni anlam alaninda yer alir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Durma, oyalanma, bekleme ve kalinan yer baglantisini en kisa bicimde tasir.

error_profile.preserves: Bekleme ve oyalanarak durma cekirdegini korur.
error_profile.loses: Kalinan yer olarak adlasmis kullanim tam olarak gorunmez.

error_profile.preserves: Durma ve bekleme eylemini korur.

error_profile.preserves: Isin imkanini bekleme yonunu korur.

error_profile.preserves: Mekan ve kalma sonucunu korur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dalda bekleyisle birlikte daha belirgin sabitlik ve yerlesme vurgusu vardir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Ikisi de hareketin ertelenmesi ve bir yerde kalma alanina girer.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal bekleyerek oyalanmayi ve imkan kollamayi kapsar; komsu dal beklemeyle birlikte sabit durus ve yerlesme tarafini daha guclu kurar.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Anlam cekirdekleri ayridir: burada eylem durup beklemek, komsuda ise bir kisiyi hedef alarak kastetmektir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir kisinin belirtisini ve sahsini amaclayarak ona yonelmeyi ve onu bilerek kastetmeyi bildirir. Dal cercevesi bu hedeflenmis kisiyi kastetme anlamini dogru ayirir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal beklemek veya yalniz bir isaret bildirmek degil, kisiyi belirtisiyle hedef almaktir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Bare kapsam, anlamin edat veya sabit kalipla degil fiilsel kastetme cekirdegiyle verilmesini gerektirir.

concept_map.definition: Bir kisinin belirtisini ve sahsini esas alarak onu bilerek hedeflemek ve kastetmek.

facets.statement: Eylemde belirli bir kisi secilir ve ona kasitli olarak yonelinir.
Kisiyi hedefleme, onun gorunen belirtisi veya sahsi uzerinden kurulur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu dali bir kisinin belirtisini ve sahsini hedefleyerek onu kastetme seklinde toplar; anlamda bilincli yonelme esastir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalniz soyut isaret degil, kisinin sahsi, topluca cikma, kitap parcasini olusturan harf toplulugu ve gunes isigini de ayni ailede verir. Dal adi kullanilabilir, fakat tanim isaret cekirdegini bu adlasmis ve kalipli uzantilardan ayirmalidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Isaret cekirdegi korunur; kisi, topluluk, metin parcasi ve gunes isigi kullanimlari buna bagli uzantilardir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mixed non-bare kapsam, yalniz ciplak isaret anlamini degil, kalipli kisi, topluluk, metin parcasi ve gunes isigi kullanimlarini ayri facetlerde tutar.

concept_map.definition: Gorunen bir belirti veya isaret; bazi kalipli kullanimlarda kisinin sahsi, toplulugun butunu, kitapta harflerden olusan parca ya da gunesin isigi icin de kullanilir.

facets.statement: Temel anlam, bir seyi tanitan veya ona delalet eden gorunen belirtidir.
Kisinin sahsi, onun taninmasini saglayan belirti gibi dusunulerek ifade edilir.
Bir toplulugun eksiksiz butunu icin de kullanilir.
Kitapta harf toplulugundan olusan belirli parca anlamina gelir.
Gunes isigi, gunesin ayirt ettirici belirtisi gibi goruldugu icin bu alana baglanir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar isaret ve belirti cekirdeginde bulusur; ayni iddia kisinin sahsi, toplulugun butunu, kitap parcasi ve gunes isigi gibi uzantilari da birlikte aktarir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal ifade edici eyleme bağlıdır; komşu dal nesnenin belirginleşmesine veya kanıt niteliğine bağlıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tamamı değerlendirildi; konuşma yetkinliği, anlatım eksikliği ve genel görünürlük sınırları yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه البيان بوصفه كشفا عن المعنى، والكلام أو الكتابة أو الإشارة التي تبين المقصود، والفصاحة واللسن.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس كل ظهور حسي بيانا لفظيا، ولا يدخل فيه مجرد الفراق أو الوسط.
branches.source_phrase_ar: أبين من فلان أي أوضح كلاما منه (maqayis)؛ البين من الرجال الفصيح (ayn)؛ البيان الفصاحة واللسن (sihah)؛ البيان الكشف عن الشيء وهو أعم من النطق (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi uzaklık ve geniş mesafe çekirdeğini, kuyu örneğinde ise ağız ile dip arasındaki uzaklığı verir. Geçici çerçeve bunu doğru taşır ve üstünlük anlamına kayan başka kullanımları dışarıda tutar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Yalın dal uzak mesafe ve büyük açıklıkla sınırlıdır; ayrılık olayı veya üstünlük anlamı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam yalındır; tanım özel kalıp yerine mesafe ve geniş açıklık çekirdeğini verir.

concept_map.definition: İki nokta, taraf veya yüzey arasında büyük uzaklık ve geniş açıklık bulunmasıdır; kuyu gibi nesnelerde ağız ile dip arasındaki uzaklık olarak görünür.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam iki şey arasında büyük uzaklık veya geniş açıklık bulunmasıdır.
Kuyu için ağız ile dip arasının uzak veya geniş olması örneklenir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar uzaklık çekirdeğini verir; kuyu örneği bu uzaklığı somut bir ağız-dip mesafesi ve genişlik olarak gösterir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Taraflar veya yüzeyler arasında belirgin mesafe ve açıklık bulunduğunda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Büyük mesafe, açıklık ve uzaklık çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İki taraf arasındaki mesafenin büyüklüğünü anlatan cümlelerde doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Taraflar arası büyük uzaklık fikrini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal uzaklık durumunu genel bir mesafe ve açıklık olarak verir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal iki şeyin birbirinden ne kadar uzak olduğunu haber verme kalıbına daha bağlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da iki şey arasındaki büyük uzaklık alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal uzak mesafe niteliğini isimsel olarak kurar; komşu dal uzaklığın bildirilmesi ve uyumsuzluk hissiyle kullanılabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal iki uç arasında açıklık veya aralık mesafesi kurar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yakın olmama durumunu genel mekansal veya soyut uzaklık olarak anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da yakın olmama ve mesafe alanını paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal aradaki mesafenin genişliğini öne çıkarır; komşu dal uzaklık durumunu daha genel tutar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal mesafe ve açıklığın büyüklüğüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal ayrılıp kopma olayını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Ayrılma sonucunda uzak mesafe ortaya çıkabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal son durumda ölçülen uzaklığı verir; komşu dal uzaklığı doğurabilen ayrılma veya kopma olayını verir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tamamı değerlendirildi; yayımlanan sınırlar uzaklık, genel mesafe ve ayrılma sonucuyla ilgilidir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه البعد بين طرفين، والبئر البعيدة القعر أو الواسعة التي يبعد ما بين شفيرها وقعرها.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه البون بمعنى الفضل والمزية إذا غلبت عليه الواو، ولا مجرد الفراق بلا دلالة بعد.
branches.source_phrase_ar: أصل واحد وهو بعد الشيء (maqayis)؛ البائنة البئر البعيدة القعر الواسعة (sihah)؛ بيون لبعد ما بين الشفير والقعر (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi toprağın göz erimine kadar uzanan parçası, yönü veya yüksekçe kalın bölgesi olarak dar bir arazi adını verir. Geçici çerçeve yer adlarını ve sırf ara-konumu dışarıda tuttuğu için uygundur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Yalın dal arazi parçası veya yönüyle sınırlıdır; iki şey arasındaki genel aralık değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam yalındır; tanım özel ad veya kalıp değil, arazi parçası anlamını verir.

concept_map.definition: Gözün uzanabildiği ölçüde görülen bir arazi parçası, tarafı, yöresi veya yer yer kabarık bölgesidir.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam göz erimine kadar uzanan bir arazi parçasıdır.
Bazı anlatımlar bunu arazi yönü, bölgesi veya kabarık sert kesimi olarak verir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar arazi parçası çekirdeğinde birleşir; anlatımlar bu parçayı göz erimi, yön veya kabarık yer parçası olarak değişik açılardan tarif eder.

concept_gloss.applicability: Gözle seçilebilen genişlikte bir yer kesimi veya yöre anlamında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Arazi parçası, yöre ve göz erimi sınırını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Gözle görülebilen yer parçası veya yöre anlamındaki akıcı kullanımlar için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yer parçası ve bölge niteliğini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: göz erimindeki arazi parçası, yöre veya kabarık yer

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal göz erimiyle ölçülen arazi kesimi veya yön olarak tarif edilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yanındakinden ayrışan leke, parça veya yer kesimi fikrini taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da arazide seçilen bir kesimi anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal göz erimi ve yöre ölçüsünü vurgular; komşu dal seçilebilir parça veya leke niteliğini öne çıkarır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal belirli bir arazi kesimi, yönü veya kabarık parçasıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal geniş, düz ve açık alan niteliğine yönelir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da yeryüzündeki geniş veya seçilebilir alanları anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal parçalanmış veya yönlenmiş bir arazi kesimidir; komşu dal açıklık ve genişlik niteliğini temel alır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal cins isim olarak arazi parçasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal belirli bir dağ veya yer adı olarak geçer.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da coğrafi alanla ilişkilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal tür adı olarak arazi kesimidir; komşu dal özel bir yer adıdır ve aynı anlam alanında tanımsal eşleşme kurmaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tamamı değerlendirildi; yer parçası, geniş arazi ve özel yer adı ayrımları en yararlı olanlardır.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه البين من الأرض: القطعة أو الناحية أو الغلظ من الأرض بقدر مد البصر.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه أسماء المواضع المسماة بين أو مبين، ولا الوسط الظرفي بين شيئين.
branches.source_phrase_ar: البين قطعة من الأرض قدر مد البصر (maqayis)؛ البين الغلظ من الأرض (jamhara)؛ البين بالكسر القطعة من الأرض قدر منتهى البصر (sihah)؛ البين أيضا الناحية (sihah)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi belirli beden, yay ve baş örneklerinde bir parçanın temas ettiği yerden ayrılması veya uzaklaşmasını verir. Geçici çerçeve bunu özel kalıplara bağlı tuttuğu sürece doğrudur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal yalnızca verilen cisimsel kalıplardaki ayrılma ve açıklıkla sınırlıdır; genel toplumsal ayrılık değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam kalıp kullanımına bağlıdır; tanım bu özel cisimsel örneklerden yalın kök anlamı üretmez.

concept_map.definition: Belirli cisimsel kalıplarda bir organın, yayın teli gibi bir parçanın ya da başın bağlı olduğu yerden ayrılması, açılması veya koparılmasıdır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam temas eden veya bağlı parçanın bulunduğu yerden ayrılmasıdır.
Hayvan uzvunun gövdeden açılması ve yay telinin gövdeden uzak durması örneklenir.
Başın gövdeden kesilip ayrılması aynı cisimsel koparma alanındadır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar belirli cisimsel örneklerde ayrılma çekirdeğini verir; bu çekirdek organ-gövde, tel-yay ve baş-gövde ilişkilerinde somutlaşır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Organ, tel veya baş gibi bir parçanın temas ettiği yerden ayrıldığı özel kalıplar için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Parçanın bağlı olduğu yerden ayrılması çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir uzvun gövdeye bitişik durmayıp yanından açıldığı bağlamda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Temas yerinden açılma anlamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Başın gövdeden kesilip ayrıldığı özel eylem bağlamında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Kesip gövdeden ayırma anlamını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal özel organ, yay teli ve baş kalıplarıyla sınırlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kesme ve koparma eylemini daha genel nesnelere uygular.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da parçanın bağlı olduğu yerden ayrılması alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal cisimsel örneklerle kayıtlıdır; komşu dal kesip ayırma işlemini daha genel verir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal belirli örneklerde ayrılıp açılma veya koparılmayı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bir şeyi başka şeyden ayırma ve bütünden çıkarma işlemini geniş tutar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir parçanın ayrılmasını konu edinir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın kullanım alanı kalıplarla sınırlıdır; komşu dal aynı işlemi daha genel bir kesme-ayırma çekirdeğinde taşır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal cisimsel parça-temas ilişkilerinde özel ayrılmadır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal genel ayrılık ve kopuş anlamıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalda da ayrılma çekirdeği bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal özel nesne kalıplarını şart koşar; komşu dal ayrılmayı genel ve yalın biçimde anlatır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tamamı değerlendirildi; genel kesme ve yalın ayrılma komşuları en güçlü sınırları sağlar.
branches.branch_image_ar: انفراج العضو أو الشيء عن ملاصقه
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه بانت يد الناقة عن جنبها، والقوس البائنة التي بان وترها عن كبدها، وإبانة الرأس من الجسد.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الفراق الاجتماعي أو الطلاق إلا بطريق معنى الانفصال العام.
branches.source_phrase_ar: بانت يد الناقة عن جنبها (ayn)؛ قوس بائن وهي التي بان وترها عن كبدها (ayn)؛ ضربه فأبان رأسه من جسده وفصله (sihah)؛ البائنة القوس التي بانت عن وترها كثيرا (sihah)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi sağma işindeki iki kişiden birini, özellikle hayvanın sol tarafından geleni belirtir. Geçici çerçeve bunu dar bir sağım terimi olarak tuttuğu için uygundur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Yalın görünse de anlam sağım alanındaki görev ve tarafla sınırlıdır; her ayrılan kişi anlamına gelmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam yalındır; tanım yine de kaynakta verilen teknik sağım rolünün dışına genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Sağımda iki sağandan biri, özellikle hayvanın sol tarafından gelen sağan kişidir; karşısında sağ taraftan gelen eş sağan bulunur.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam sağım işindeki iki kişiden bir sağandır.
Bu sağan özellikle hayvanın sol tarafından gelen kişi olarak ayırt edilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar sağımda iki kişilik rol ayrımını verir; bu dal o iki kişiden birini ve özellikle sol taraftan gelen sağanı karşı tarafındaki sağanla ayırır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Sağımda hayvanın belirli yanından gelen sağan için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Sağım rolünü ve sol yan ayırımını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yan bilgisinin önemli olmadığı ama teknik sağım rolünün açıklanması gereken yerlerde uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Sağım işindeki ikili rolü korur.
error_profile.loses: Sol taraftan gelme ayrıntısını açıkça vermez.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: sağımda hayvanın sol yanından gelen sağan

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal sağım yapan kişinin teknik görev adıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal sol yan ve sol taraf kavramının kendisini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalda da sol taraf bilgisi kullanılır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal sol tarafı sağım rolünün ayırıcı şartı olarak kullanır; komşu dal sol tarafı bağımsız yön anlamı olarak verir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal sağım işindeki kişi ve konum rolünü adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal memedeki sütü tamamen sağma eylemini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da sağım alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal eylemi yapan görevli kişiyi ayırır; komşu dal yapılan sağma işlemini çekirdek yapar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal sağan kişinin hangi taraftan geldiğini belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bir hayvanın birden çok sağım kabına süt vermesi veya sağım duruşuyla ilgilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal sağım sahnesinde yer alır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal insan rolüdür; komşu dal sağılacak hayvanın durumuna ve süt akışına yönelir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tamamı değerlendirildi; sol yön, sağma eylemi ve sağılacak hayvanla kurulan sınırlar yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه البائن في الحلب: أحد الحالبين أو الذي يأتي الحلوبة من قبل شمالها مقابل المستعلي أو المعلى.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه كل فاعل مفارق أو كل بائن مطلقا، بل اصطلاح الحلب وحده.
branches.source_phrase_ar: البائن أحد الحالبين والآخر يسمى المستعلي (ayn)؛ البائن الذي يأتي الحلوبة من قبل شمالها والمعلى من قبل يمينها (sihah)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi belirli biçimlerin zaman bağlacı gibi kullanılarak bir olayın başka bir durum sürerken gerçekleşmesini verdiğini gösterir. Geçici çerçeve bu zaman işlevini doğru biçimde korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal yalnızca zaman bağlacı işlevindeki biçimlerle sınırlıdır; yer aralığı veya genel orta anlamı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam yalın olmayan biçimdedir; tanım yalnızca bu zaman bağlacı biçimlerini kapsar.

concept_map.definition: Bir durum veya eylem sürerken başka bir olayın gerçekleştiğini bildiren zaman bağlacı kullanımıdır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam bir eylem veya durum sırasında başka olayın gerçekleşmesidir.
Bu işlev belirli biçimlerin zaman sözü gibi kullanılmasına bağlıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu dalı zaman bağlacı işleviyle açıklar; biçim, bir olayın bekleme veya başka bir sürmekte olan durum içinde gerçekleşmesini bildirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir olayın başka bir eylem veya durum devam ederken gerçekleştiği zaman bağlacı bağlamında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Sürmekte olan durum içindeki zaman ilişkisini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir olayın başka bir bekleme veya gözleme durumu sırasında geliştiği anlatımlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Sürmekte olan eylem sırasında gerçekleşme anlamını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal bir cümleyi sürmekte olan zamana bağlayan belirli bağlaç biçimidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal şeyin genel vakti veya uygun zamanı anlamındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da zaman ve vaktin bildirilmesi alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal olaylar arası eşzamanlılık bağlacı olarak çalışır; komşu dal bağımsız zaman veya vakit adıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal sürmekte olan bir durum içinde yeni olayın gerçekleşmesini bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal genel zaman, dönem veya tekrar eden vakitleri anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da zaman belirleme alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal cümle bağlayan eşzamanlılık işlevindedir; komşu dal daha genel zaman adı olarak kalır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal zaman içinde olma bağlacı olarak kullanılır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yer veya ilişki bakımından arada olmayı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalda da aralık fikri tarihsel veya kavramsal bir köprü kurar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal aralığı zamansal cümle ilişkisine çevirir; komşu dal mekansal veya topluluksal ara konumda kalır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tamamı değerlendirildi; genel zaman adları ve aynı kökün ara-konum dalı en yararlı sınırları verdi.
branches.branch_image_ar: الوقت الواقع أثناء حال أو فعل
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه بينا وبينما إذا جعلتا بمنزلة حين وأضافتا الجملة إلى زمن الفعل.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه بين الظرفية المكانية إلا من جهة أصل الظرفية.
branches.source_phrase_ar: قولك بينا فلان معناه بينما (ayn)؛ بينا نحن نرقبه أتانا أي أتانا بين أوقات رقبتنا إياه (sihah)؛ يزاد في بين ما أو الألف فيجعل بمنزلة حين (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi belirli tekrar biçiminde iki uç arasında kalan ara durumları, ayrıca zayıf ve dikkate alınmaz düşmeyi verir. Geçici çerçeve bunu kalıba bağlı orta hal olarak doğru yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal yalnızca tekrar biçimindeki ara-hal kullanımıdır; genel ara konum dalıyla özdeş değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam yalın olmayan biçimdedir; tanım tekrar kalıbının ara ve zayıf hal kullanımıyla sınırlıdır.

concept_map.definition: İki uç değer arasında kalan ara veya orta haldir; kimi örneklerde bu aralık zayıflık ve hesaba katılmama olarak görünür.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam iki uç arasında kalan orta veya ara haldir.
İyi ile kötü arasında olma veya sesin iki söyleyiş arasında kalması örneklenir.

facets.statement: Atın yelesi veya horozun ibiği gibi gövdeden yükselip belirginleşen bir üst parça vardır.
Yüksek arazi, kum sırtı, duvar, rüzgâr ya da bulutun üst kısmı aynı görünür yükseltiyle adlandırılır.
Atın belirgin yele kısmının kırpılması, bu parçaya bağlı özel bir eylem olarak ifade edilir.
Dalganın yükselmesi veya sıvının köpüğünün belirginleşmesi yele biçimli kabarma olarak anlatılır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal çoğu kez sırt veya kenar gibi uzanan bir yükseltiyi, komşu dal ise daha yerel bir baş ya da uç çıkıntısını öne çıkarır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; kum sırtı ve gövde üzerindeki çıkıntı, dalın biçim sınırını en açık gösteren komşulardır.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه عرف الفرس والديك، وموضع نبات العرف أو جزه، والرمل أو الأرض المرتفعة، والأعراف والسور العالي، وأعالي الرياح والسحاب، وارتفاع الموج أو الزبد، وما له شعر أو سنام ظاهر.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه التتابع إلا من جهة تشبيه التتابع بالعرف، ولا يدخل فيه المعروف أو المعرفة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: العرف عرف الفرس (maqayis;sihah;tahdhib;mufradat)؛ العرفة أرض منقادة مرتفعة (maqayis)؛ عرفت الفرس أي جززت عرفه (sihah)؛ الأعراف جمع عرف وهو كل عال مرتفع (tahdhib)؛ العرف والعرف الرمل المرتفع (sihah)؛ أعراف الرياح والسحاب أوائلها وأعاليها (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, bir şeyi veya kişiyi izinden ya da belirtisinden hareketle düşünüp ayırt etmeyi çekirdek yapar. Karşılıklı tanıma, bildirme, bilinir kılma ve araştırarak öğrenme kullanımları bu bilişsel çekirdeğe bağlı işlemlerdir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Salt bilgi sahibi olma kadar geniş değildir; tanıma, ayırt etme veya bunu başkasına bildirme işlemini gerektirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanıma çekirdeği ile karşılıklı tanıma, bildirme ve araştırarak öğrenme yapıları ayrı tutulur; hiçbir kalıp bütün dala yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi ya da kişiyi bir iz, belirti veya düşünme süreci üzerinden tanıyıp başkalarından ayırt etmektir. Karşılıklı tanıma, bir şeyi bilinir kılma ve araştırarak öğrenme bu çekirdeğe bağlı işlemlerdir.

facets.statement: Bir şey, kişide bıraktığı iz veya sunduğu belirti üzerinde düşünülerek tanınır ve ayırt edilir.
Bir topluluğun üyeleri karşılıklı olarak birbirlerini tanır.
Bir bilgi başkasına bildirilir veya bir şey bilinir duruma getirilir.
Bir haber ya da durum, araştırılıp izlenerek sonunda öğrenilir.
Bir anlatının yalnızca bir bölümü bildirilir ya da bir yer önceden betimlenip tanınır kılınır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar tanıma ve ayırt etmeyi ortak çekirdek olarak sunar; karşılıklı tanıma, bildirme ve araştırma yoluyla öğrenme bu çekirdekten türeyen işlemler olarak yer alır.

concept_gloss.text: bir iz veya belirti üzerinden tanıyıp ayırt etme
concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın bilişsel çekirdeğini, salt bilmeden farklı olarak tanıma ve ayrıştırma işlemiyle verir.

error_profile.preserves: İz veya belirtiye dayanmayı, tanımayı ve ayırt etmeyi birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişi ya da şeyin belirtilerinden hareketle kimliğinin veya niteliğinin kavrandığı bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Tanıma ile başkalarından ayırma işlemlerini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir bilginin başkasına aktarıldığı veya bir şeyin tanıtıldığı yapılarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bilgiyi başkasına aktarma ve bilinir duruma getirme işlemini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin elindeki haber veya durum soruşturma sonunda öğrenildiğinde uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Bilgiye arama ve araştırma sonunda ulaşma koşulunu korur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal genel bilgi edinme alanıdır; odak dal ise bir şeyi izinden tanıyıp ayırt etmeyi ve bu tanımayı başkasına aktarmayı gerektirir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir şeyi belirtisinden tanıma, bilme ve başkasından ayırma sonucunu taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bilginin yokluğunu veya bir şeyi olduğundan başka sanmayı ifade eder.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Karşıtlık, bir şey hakkında doğru bilgiye sahip olma ekseninde kurulur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal tanıma ve ayırt etmeyle bilgiye ulaşmayı, komşu dal ise bu bilginin bulunmamasını veya yanlış kurulmasını anlatır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel bilgi alanı ile bilgisizlik karşıtı, tanımanın hem yakın hem karşıt sınırını en iyi gösterir.
branches.branch_image_ar: معرفة وتمييز بعد أثر أو علامة
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه المعرفة والعرفان، تمييز الشيء أو الشخص، التعارف، التعريف بمعنى الإعلام أو جعل الشيء معروفا، وتعرف الخبر أو الحال بطلبه.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الإقرار بالذنب إذا كان معنى الاعتراف، ولا المعروف الأخلاقي، ولا العرافة أو منصب العريف.
branches.source_phrase_ar: عرف فلان فلانا عرفانا ومعرفة (maqayis)؛ عرفت الشيء معرفة وعرفانا (ayn;sihah;tahdhib)؛ المعرفة والعرفان إدراك الشيء بتفكر وتدبر لأثره (mufradat)؛ تعارف القوم أي عرف بعضهم بعضا (sihah;mufradat)؛ التعريف الإعلام (sihah)؛ تعرفت ما عند فلان أي تطلبت حتى عرفت (sihah)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü koku anlamını ve güzel kokulu duruma getirme işlemini destekler; ancak kokunun yalnız hoş mu yoksa hoş olmayan kokuyu da mı kapsadığı konusunda kaynaklar ayrılır. Ayrıca bir kişinin güzel kokuyu çok kullanması ile bırakması biçiminde karşıt iki açıklama tek ve kararlı bir eylem anlamı gibi birleştirilemez.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek genel koku olarak verilir; hoş kokuyla sınırlayan görüş ve karşıt kişi kullanımları ayrıca işaretlenir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Koku bildiren biçim ile güzel kokulu duruma getiren yapılar ayrılır; kişi hakkındaki karşıt açıklama yalnız kendi özel kullanımında tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyden yayılan kokuyu, bazı kaynaklarda yalnız hoş kokuyu, bazı kaynaklarda ise hoş veya kötü her kokuyu anlatır. Güzel kokulu duruma getirme ve süsleme kullanımları bu duyusal çekirdeğe bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyden yayılan koku, niteliği hoş ya da kötü olabilen duyusal bir özellik olarak adlandırılır.
Bazı kaynaklar koku anlamını yalnız hoş kokuyla sınırlar.
Bir şey güzel kokulu duruma getirilir ve buna bağlı olarak süslenmiş sayılır.
Bir kişi için güzel kokuyu çok kullanma ve güzel kokuyu bırakma biçiminde karşıt açıklamalar aktarılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar koku ve güzel kokulu duruma getirme alanında birleşir; koku kapsamının yalnız hoş kokuyla mı sınırlı olduğu ve kişi kullanımının çok kullanma mı bırakma mı bildirdiği konusunda kaynak içi farklılıklar vardır.

concept_gloss.text: koku; ayrıca güzel kokulu duruma getirme
concept_gloss.applicability: Koku çekirdeğini ve ona bağlı kokulandırma işlemini, kaynak ayrılığını gizlemeden birlikte gösterir.

error_profile.preserves: Genel koku kapsamını, hoş koku sınırlamasını ve kokulandırma işlemini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kokunun hoş veya kötü olabildiği genel ad kullanımında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Kokuyu hoşluk değeri eklemeden duyusal özellik olarak korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yemek veya başka bir şey hoş kokuyla işlendiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir şeye hoş koku kazandırma işlemini açıkça korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: hoş ya da kötü olabilen koku
